subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live owner-session Telegram proof before merge, or may it merge on source and CI evidence only?
rationale: The diff changes visible session/message delivery for Telegram topic completions, and the PR body still lists live proof as pending while the Mantis proof workflow skipped.

options.title: Require live owner-session proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only delivery risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes completion messages.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery contract
options.body: If maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, exec, ACP, and subagent paths, pause this PR and fold the useful tests into that design.

recommendation.title: Require live owner-session proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a cross-cutting subagent/heartbeat delivery proof call, and Peter shows relevant subagent announce history plus recent current-main ownership context.
